newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Yields fall on Bulgaria 1-,4-week discount T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Yields fall on Bulgaria 1-,4-week discount T-bills.

text.p: Yields fell at Monday's auctions of Bulgaria's Finance Ministry one-week and four-week discount T-bills, central bank figures showed.
The average yields to maturity of the two issues were 1.95 percent and 12.75 percent, respectively, down from 2.44 and 14.16 percent at Friday's auctions.
Bids were received for a total of 88.693 billion levs of T-bills for today's auctions but the ministry approved bids for 38.384 billion levs worth of paper.
Details of the issues follow. Prices in percent of par:
Par value 25,000 million levs 40,000 million levs
Bids received 32,664.1 million levs 56,028.5 million levs
Bids approved 16,605.4 million levs 21,778.5 million levs
Avg yield to maturity 1.95 pct 12.75 pct
